tagline: Finding your way through grants and funding
h1: Grants, vouchers and funding in one place
lede: European, national, regional and local grants for Italian citizens and businesses, including not-yet-incorporated ones. Data imported daily from official sources, filterable by region, sector and audience.
newsletter_lede: Sign up and get notified when a grant matching your filters is published. No spam: unsubscribe anytime.
newsletter_success: Check your email to confirm your subscription.
newsletter_confirmed: Subscription confirmed. You'll get an email when a matching grant is published.
newsletter_unsubscribed: Subscription cancelled. You will no longer receive notifications.
canali_lede: The registry of official sources we check to find grants, vouchers and funding across Italy: national and EU bodies, Regions, regional finance agencies, Chambers of Commerce, Local Action Groups and thematic sources.
footer_disclaimer: Information is provided for guidance only: always check requirements on the issuing body's official website before applying.
cookie_text: We use only technical cookies needed for the site, and, if accepted, one to remember your language. No advertising tracking.
novita_lede: Notices, decrees and news about grants published by the bodies we follow. Many calls are announced this way before they appear in official listings: here you find them as soon as they are out, with a direct link to the source.
en_note: Calls from Italian sources are shown in Italian, as published by the issuing body.
try_sim: Estimate the grant with the calculator
lead_title: Need a hand with this call?
lead_lede: Leave your contact details: we will get back to you to check whether you qualify and how to apply. The request is free and without obligation.
lead_consenso: I consent to the processing of my data in order to be contacted, as described in the privacy notice.
lead_ok: Request sent. We will contact you as soon as possible.
lead_err: Request not sent: check the details and try again.
scad_lede: Calls closing in the coming days, by date. Pick a region to see the ones relevant to you, national calls included.
scad_empty: No calls closing in the chosen period.
sim_lede: Estimate in seconds how much you could get from the main incentives. Estimates are free and non-binding: the official rules are those of the call. Calculators are in Italian.
